tables.name: headline
tables.label: Right now
tables.description: One row: the state of the machine at the moment of the last snapshot — cores, load, how many Claude processes and agents are running, how many prompts are waiting. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace, so a refresh overwrites rather than accumulates). Seeded empty and never hand-edited: a reading is only ever what the machine actually reported.

provenance.source: fleet-snapshot.sh on the Mac → https://167.233.64.97/fleet/snapshot.json (Refresh action)

tables.name: sessions
tables.label: Sessions
tables.description: One row per Claude session active in the last 15 minutes: which model, how long since it last did anything, and how many prompts are queued behind it. Numbered, never named — no session ids leave the machine.

tables.name: agents
tables.label: Agents
tables.description: One row per subagent that has written output in the last 10 minutes — how long it has been running and how long since its last write. A high count here with a high load is the signature of an over-parallelised round.

tables.name: prompts
tables.label: Prompt cost
tables.description: The most recent finished prompts and what each one actually cost: tokens the main session wrote, tokens its agents wrote, how many agents it spawned, and how long it ran. Prompt TEXT never leaves the machine — only the cost shape. This is the table that makes prompts cheaper over time.

tables.name: history
tables.label: History
tables.description: One row per snapshot taken, oldest first — the efficiency log. The full history stays on the Mac; this is the light tail of it (last 240 readings) so trends are visible from anywhere.

tables.name: forge_system
tables.label: Forge: right now
tables.description: One row: the forge server's load, memory, swap, disk and uptime at its last snapshot. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: forge_top_cpu
tables.label: Forge: top CPU
tables.description: The ten processes on the forge server with the highest average CPU since they started (not instantaneous).

tables.name: forge_top_ram
tables.label: Forge: top RAM
tables.description: The ten processes on the forge server using the most memory.

tables.name: forge_services
tables.label: Forge: services
tables.description: The forge services and whether each is active, with the memory of its main process only.

tables.name: forge_hist
tables.label: Forge: over time
tables.description: The last 24 hours of server readings (CPU, load, memory), one row per snapshot. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_system
tables.label: Edge: right now
tables.description: One row: the edge server's disk, load and memory at its last snapshot. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_categories
tables.label: Edge: disk by category
tables.description: The edge disk's used space split by owner (downloads, data feeds, database, backups, transit planner, docker, system), re-measured hourly.

tables.name: edge_history
tables.label: Edge: history
tables.description: The newest 168 hourly readings of edge disk, load and memory, newest first. The box keeps the full year.

tables.name: edge_top_cpu
tables.label: Edge: top CPU
tables.description: The five programs on the edge with the highest average CPU since they started, grouped by program name.

tables.name: edge_top_ram
tables.label: Edge: top RAM
tables.description: The five programs on the edge using the most memory, grouped by program name.

tables.name: ai_connections
tables.label: AI connections
tables.description: One row per AI connection this device knows about: whether a Claude API key is configured (app names only, never the key) and whether a forge or local model answers. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local and host-computed, not synced; the web app cannot reach a local forge, and says so rather than reporting it down.

provenance.source: isan host: this device's own AI provider settings + a 3-second reachability probe (sysmonAiConnections hostCall)

tables.name: ai_budget
tables.label: AI spend
tables.description: One row: this month's ESTIMATED Claude API spend on this device against the budget set on the slider (tokens times published per-million prices). An estimate, not billing truth: the real hard cap is the Console workspace spend limit on Anthropic's side. Forge and local models are never counted. Device-local and host-computed, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: engine AiSpendMeter (tokens x published prices), persisted device-locally (sysmonAiConnections hostCall)

tables.name: forge_cores
tables.label: Forge: CPU by core
tables.description: The last 3 hours of per-core CPU readings, one row per core per minute (value = percent busy). Feeds the core heatmap and the busiest-core bars. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: forge_hist3h
tables.label: Forge: last 3 hours
tables.description: The last 3 hours of forge readings, one row per minute: CPU, load, memory, swap, disk used and total (GB) and uptime (seconds). Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: forge_gaps
tables.label: Forge: downtime gaps
tables.description: Periods when the forge machine stopped reporting (from / to, stored as epoch seconds and shown as local date and time). Empty means no gaps were recorded. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: forge_boots
tables.label: Forge: reboots
tables.description: When the forge machine rebooted (epoch seconds, shown as local date and time). Empty means no reboot was recorded. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace; one scalar per row in the "value" column). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_cores
tables.label: Edge: CPU by core
tables.description: The last 3 hours of per-core CPU readings, one row per core per minute (value = percent busy). Feeds the core heatmap and the busiest-core bars. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_hist3h
tables.label: Edge: last 3 hours
tables.description: The last 3 hours of edge readings, one row per minute: CPU, load, memory, swap, disk used and total (GB) and uptime (seconds). Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_gaps
tables.label: Edge: downtime gaps
tables.description: Periods when the edge machine stopped reporting (from / to, stored as epoch seconds and shown as local date and time). Empty means no gaps were recorded. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: edge_boots
tables.label: Edge: reboots
tables.description: When the edge machine rebooted (epoch seconds, shown as local date and time). Empty means no reboot was recorded. Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace; one scalar per row in the "value" column). Seeded empty and never hand-edited.

tables.name: managed_apps
tables.label: Managed apps
tables.description: One row per app the platform knows about: every bundled applet plus the external tools listed in the bundled managed-externals file. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local and host-computed, not synced. Spend reads 'not reported' until an app reports it — never 0. Read-only in this round.

provenance.source: isan host: bundled apps list + each app.json + managed-externals.json (+ the app registry when reachable) (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: managed_platforms
tables.label: App platforms
tables.description: One row per app per platform (web, android, macos): whether a production build is available, its build stamp, the last build time and the latest build job state. 'unknown' means the build feed could not be reached, not that nothing exists. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: public builds feed (/t4/builds-status.json) via the builds client (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: command_meta
tables.label: Action status
tables.description: One row: whether this account can run app actions right now (signed out, not allowed, quota left). Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: GET /fapi/command with the signed-in user's own token (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: services
tables.label: Services
tables.description: The allowlisted edge and forge service units and their current status as the edge reports it ('not installed' when a unit is absent). Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: svc.ctl status via /fapi/command (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: command_feed
tables.label: What happened
tables.description: The signed-in user's own recent app-management actions (newest first): what was asked, on which app, and how it ended. Read from the server's immutable command log; nothing here is editable. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: the user's own command_log rows on the main PocketBase (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: book_service
tables.label: Book Translator service
tables.description: Status of the forge book-jobs service and its providers (Ollama, LibreTranslate, Claude) plus whether a new translation can start. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: public feed /t4/book-jobs-status.json and svc.ctl status via /fapi/command (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: book_spend
tables.label: Book Translator spend
tables.description: One row: this month's Claude spend against the monthly book budget, what is left and the queue depth. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local, not synced.

tables.name: book_jobs
tables.label: Your translations
tables.description: The signed-in owner's own translation jobs from book.status via /fapi/command: language, provider, pages, state (with refused sections counted), cost. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: book.status via /fapi/command with the signed-in user's own token (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)

tables.name: align_summary
tables.label: Id alignment summary
tables.description: One row: how many applets have an id that matches their display name (aligned / all applets compared) and how many differ. Read-only check (spec 14, decision 1); ids only change through the approved migration. Rewritten on Refresh. Device-local and host-computed, not synced.

provenance.source: isan host: bundled apps list + each app.json + the app registry name overrides (sysmonManagedApps hostCall)
